scripts.db:console:local: pnpm --filter @maktabah/storefront exec wrangler d1 execute maktabah --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state --command
scripts.db:create: pnpm --filter @maktabah/storefront exec wrangler d1 create maktabah
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @maktabah/storefront exec wrangler d1 migrations apply maktabah --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @maktabah/storefront exec wrangler d1 migrations apply maktabah --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.db:seed: pnpm db:seed:build && pnpm --filter @maktabah/storefront exec wrangler d1 execute maktabah --remote --file=../../packages/db/seed/catalog.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm db:seed:build && pnpm --filter @maktabah/storefront exec wrangler d1 execute maktabah --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state --file=../../packages/db/seed/catalog.sql
scripts.test: pnpm db:verify && pnpm db:test && pnpm html:test
